doc: Absolute ceilings. compare.py fails when the head value of a listed metric is above the entry's limit, whatever the base holds. Fields: metric (component.metric), scope ("total" or a dataset id; default total), limit (the highest head value allowed), reason. Lower a limit when a change brings the head below it; compare.py lists ceilings the head is below.

Lower the limit as fixes merge; the target is 0.
